title: Keep sequenced session reads from advancing the global event revision
outcome: Keep sequenced session reads from advancing the global event revision
acceptance: A public local-session regression receives an eligible paired tail read at global revision R+3 before a queued SessionCreated at R+1 and proves the new session and metadata remain visible without an unrelated later snapshot; a refused local paired read cannot advance the global ledger.

Eligible paired local tail and body-bearing creation/fork adoption leave the latest global revision unchanged in every session-read admission/refusal branch. Excluded remote, foreign-epoch and unpaired session reads preserve master's classifier and revision effects. Normal global action-response processing is not promoted to a body certificate.
The exact corrected input passes focused regressions, the full five-stage gate and a fresh complete independent Codex/Claude pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
